1594330878268039170.a: The key takeaway I got from this article, since it isn't obvious, is palmitic acid needs to be balanced with the appropriate polyunsaturated fats. If you eat keto friendly oils _only_ then that has the opposite effect and can make you susceptible to sepsis and excessive swelling.

1594332661421674502.a: My rule is to mix different types of oil when cooking my meals. Grapeseed oil, olive oil, coconut oil, butter, lard. I might cook meat in grapeseed or olive oil. Veggies in coconut oil. Etc. I tend to fry things like chicken in coconut and/or grapeseed.

1594333479210213377.a: With coconut oil you need to read the label carefully as well. I like to use unrefined cold press coconut oil for frying. It is aromatic and has a smoke point of 450F. Other cheaper forms will be for pastries (350F) and sauces; good for things that sit at room temp like cookies.
